sources.title: Google Search Central Documentation
principles: Ensure HTTP 200 responses for indexable pages with valid content.
Maintain accessible sitemap.xml and robots.txt without blocking indexable content.
Use absolute, self-referential or intended target canonical links.

sources.title: Google Search Central Official Blog
principles: Focus on genuine user utility, original reporting, and real market experiences.
Avoid chasing algorithmic quirks or speculative SEO hacks.

sources.title: Google Search Essentials (formerly Webmaster Guidelines)
principles: Serve valid HTML that Googlebot can parse.
Avoid deceptive redirects, cloaking, and scraped content.
Provide unique, descriptive title tags and meaningful meta descriptions.

sources.title: Google SEO Starter Guide
principles: Structure pages logically with a single prominent H1 heading per document.
Use descriptive anchor text for internal links rather than generic 'click here'.
Add meaningful, contextual alt text to informative images; omit or empty alt for purely decorative icons.

sources.title: Google Search Spam Policies
principles: Scaled content abuse: mass-producing low-value, programmatic or unverified AI content violates spam policy.
Ensure commercial claims, pricing, and warranties are factual and verifiable.
Never hide text or links using CSS tricks or microscopic fonts.

sources.title: Google Guidance for Generative AI & AI Search Experiences
principles: AI Search systems prioritize direct, factually verifiable answers with transparent source attribution.
Structured data (Schema.org Product, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList) provides clear semantic cues for answer engines.
Do not invent special GEO/AEO tricks or manipulate hidden prompts in markup; clear, concise text wins.
Expose clean markdown or text knowledge bases (e.g., llms.txt, llms-full.txt) to aid large language models.

sources.title: Google Search Console Help & Inspection Guide
principles: HTTP 200 or sitemap presence does not guarantee indexing.
Use URL Inspection selectively for high-priority new or materially improved URLs within daily quotas.
Never submit entire sites repeatedly daily; respect Google's autonomous discovery.

sources.title: Search Console API Documentation
principles: Search analytics queries are aggregated across rolling date windows (typically 2-3 day lag).
Handle OAuth token refreshes gracefully without storing credentials in code or version control.
